description:
Title: OEE

Write a process, that collects relevant information from a machine, and calculated the Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE).
If the OEE falls below a certain value/percentage, stop the machine and send an email to an engineer.
When the machine is restarted, continue measuring.
When the machine is disconnected, stop the process.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_OEE" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/oee">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OEE" name="Start OEE measurement">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Measure</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Restart_Measure</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_MachineRestarted" messageRef="Msg_MachineRestarted"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_MeasureOEE" name="Measure OEE">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Measure</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Restart_Measure</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Measure_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_MeasureOEE" name="Measurement started">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Measure_Merge" name="Measure">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OEE_Continue</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_Collect</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectMachineData" name="Collect machine data">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_Collect</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Collect_Calculate</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate OEE">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Collect_Calculate</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Calculate_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OEEThreshold_Split" name="OEE below threshold?" default="Flow_OEE_Continue">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Calculate_Split</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OEE_Below</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OEE_Continue</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
      <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StopMachine" name="Stop machine">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OEE_Below</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stop_Email</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:serviceTask>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEmailEngineer" name="Send email to engineer">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stop_Email</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Email_End</bpmn:outgoing>
      </bpmn:sendTask>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MachineHalted" name="Machine halted, engineer notified">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Email_End</bpmn:incoming>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Merge" sourceRef="StartEvent_MeasureOEE" targetRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Collect" sourceRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge" targetRef="Task_CollectMachineData"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Calculate" sourceRef="Task_CollectMachineData" targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Calculate_Split" sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE" targetRef="Gateway_OEEThreshold_Split"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_Below" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OEEThreshold_Split" targetRef="Task_StopMachine"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OEE_Continue" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OEEThreshold_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Measure_Merge"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stop_Email" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Task_SendEmailEngineer"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_End" sourceRef="Task_SendEmailEngineer" targetRef="EndEvent_MachineHalted"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected" attachedToRef="SubProcess_MeasureOEE" cancelActivity="true">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disconnected_Stop</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_MachineDisconnected" messageRef="Msg_MachineDisconnected"/>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StopProcess" name="Stop process">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disconnected_Stop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Stop_Process_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_MeasurementEnded" name="Measurement ended">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Measure_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessStopped" name="Process stopped">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Stop_Process_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Measure" sourceRef="StartEvent_OEE" targetRef="SubProcess_MeasureOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restart_Measure" sourceRef="StartEvent_MachineRestarted" targetRef="SubProcess_MeasureOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Measure_End" sourceRef="SubProcess_MeasureOEE" targetRef="EndEvent_MeasurementEnded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnected_Stop" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_MachineDisconnected" targetRef="Task_StopProcess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Stop_Process_End" sourceRef="Task_StopProcess" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessStopped"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
